-- Returns True when the request path stays inside the notes directory.
-- Rejects absolute paths, any path that climbs out with "..", and the empty path.
inside_notes(path: str) -> bool =
  ex inside_notes("sub/../a.txt") == True
  ex inside_notes("../x") == False
  ex inside_notes("sub/../../x") == False
  ex inside_notes("/etc/passwd") == False
  ex inside_notes("") == False
  let parts = path.split("/")
  -- An empty first component means a leading "/" or an empty path.
  if parts[0] == ""
    return False
  var depth = 0
  for p in parts
    if p == ".."
      depth -= 1
      if depth < 0
        return False
    if p != ".." and p != "." and p != ""
      depth += 1
  True

-- Returns the text of notes/path, or "" when the path leaves notes
-- or the file is missing or unreadable.
read_public(path: str) -> str uses fs =
  ex read_public("missing-file-zzz") == ""
  ex read_public("../secret") == ""
  ex read_public("/etc/passwd") == ""
  if not inside_notes(path)
    return ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    let text = fs.read(path) else ""
    text
